structures.label: Upper arm bone
structures.sentence: The bone of your upper arm. Its rounded top sits in the shoulder socket.

structures.label: Shoulder blade
structures.sentence: The flat, triangle-shaped bone on your upper back. It holds the shoulder socket.

structures.label: Collarbone
structures.sentence: The bone across the top of your chest, from your breastbone to your shoulder.

structures.label: Front of the shoulder muscle
structures.sentence: The front part of the big rounded muscle on your shoulder. It lifts your arm forward.

structures.label: Side of the shoulder muscle
structures.sentence: The middle part of the big rounded muscle on your shoulder. It lifts your arm out to the side.

structures.label: Back of the shoulder muscle
structures.sentence: The back part of the big rounded muscle on your shoulder. It moves your arm backward.

structures.label: Top rotator cuff muscle
structures.sentence: A rotator cuff muscle on top of the shoulder blade. It helps start lifting your arm.

structures.label: Back rotator cuff muscle
structures.sentence: A rotator cuff muscle on the back of the shoulder blade. It turns your arm outward.

structures.label: Small back rotator cuff muscle
structures.sentence: A small rotator cuff muscle below the infraspinatus. It also turns your arm outward.

structures.label: Front rotator cuff muscle
structures.sentence: A rotator cuff muscle on the front of the shoulder blade, against the ribs. It turns your arm inward.

joints.label: AC joint
joints.sentence: Where your collarbone meets the top of your shoulder blade.

joints.label: Shoulder joint
joints.sentence: The ball-and-socket joint: the top of your upper arm bone sits in your shoulder blade's socket.

landmarks._comment: Anatomy points used to fit the region to the patient (src/scene/patientRegions.js anatomyAnchors).

structures.label: Top neck bone (C1)
structures.sentence: The ring-shaped top bone of your neck. Your head rests on it and nods on it.

structures.label: Second neck bone (C2)
structures.sentence: The second neck bone. Your head turns side to side around a peg on it.

structures.label: Neck bone C3
structures.sentence: One of the seven small bones stacked in your neck.

structures.label: Neck bone C4
structures.sentence: One of the seven small bones stacked in your neck.

structures.label: Neck bone C5
structures.sentence: One of the seven small bones stacked in your neck. Nerves to your shoulder leave near here.

structures.label: Neck bone C6
structures.sentence: One of the seven small bones stacked in your neck. Nerves to your arm leave near here.

structures.label: Neck bone C7
structures.sentence: The lowest neck bone. It's the bump you can feel at the base of your neck.

structures.label: Neck discs
structures.sentence: Soft cushions between the neck bones that absorb shock and let your neck bend.

structures.label: Side neck muscle
structures.sentence: The strap muscle on each side of your neck. It turns and tilts your head.

structures.label: Back of the neck muscle
structures.sentence: A muscle at the back of your neck that tips your head back and turns it.

structures.label: Shoulder lifting muscle
structures.sentence: Runs from your neck to your shoulder blade and lifts your shoulder.

structures.label: Upper trapezius
structures.sentence: The top of the big flat muscle across your upper back. It shrugs your shoulders.

joints.label: Neck joint (C4–C5)
joints.anatomical: Joints between the C4 and C5 vertebrae
joints.sentence: Where two neck bones meet and move against each other.

structures.label: Upper back bone T1
structures.sentence: One of the twelve back bones your ribs attach to.

structures.sentence: One of the twelve back bones your ribs attach to.

structures.label: Upper back discs
structures.sentence: Soft cushions between the upper back bones.

structures.label: Shoulder blade squeezing muscle
structures.sentence: Pulls your shoulder blades toward your spine.

structures.label: Small shoulder blade muscle
structures.sentence: Helps pull your shoulder blades toward your spine.

structures.label: Middle trapezius
structures.sentence: The middle of the big flat muscle across your upper back. It pulls your shoulders back.

structures.label: Lower trapezius
structures.sentence: The lower part of the big flat muscle across your upper back. It draws your shoulder blades down.

structures.label: Long back muscle
structures.sentence: A long muscle along your spine that keeps you upright and lets you lean back.

joints.label: Upper back joint (T6–T7)
joints.anatomical: Joints between the T6 and T7 vertebrae
joints.sentence: Where two upper back bones meet.

structures.label: Lower back bone L1
structures.sentence: One of the five large bones of your lower back. They carry most of your body's weight.

structures.label: Lower back bone L2
structures.sentence: One of the five large bones of your lower back. They carry most of your body's weight.

structures.label: Lower back bone L3
structures.sentence: One of the five large bones of your lower back. They carry most of your body's weight.

structures.label: Lower back bone L4
structures.sentence: One of the five large bones of your lower back. They carry most of your body's weight.

structures.label: Lower back bone L5
structures.sentence: One of the five large bones of your lower back. They carry most of your body's weight.

structures.label: Base of the spine
structures.sentence: The triangle-shaped bone at the base of your spine, between your hip bones.

structures.label: Hip bones
structures.sentence: The two large bones that form your pelvis. Your spine and legs attach to them.

structures.label: Lower back discs
structures.sentence: Thick cushions between the lower back bones that absorb shock when you move.

structures.label: Lower back muscle
structures.sentence: A long muscle beside your spine that straightens and steadies your lower back.

structures.label: Deep hip flexor
structures.sentence: A deep muscle from your lower spine to your thigh. It lifts your leg and steadies your spine.

joints.label: Lower back joint (L4–L5)
joints.anatomical: Joints between the L4 and L5 vertebrae
joints.sentence: Where two lower back bones meet. This level does a lot of the bending.

structures.label: Thigh bone
structures.sentence: The long bone of your thigh, the strongest bone in your body.

structures.label: Shin bone
structures.sentence: The main bone of your lower leg. It carries your weight down to your ankle.

structures.label: Thin lower leg bone
structures.sentence: The thin bone beside your shin bone. Muscles attach to it.

structures.label: Kneecap
structures.sentence: The small bone at the front of your knee. It helps your thigh muscle straighten your leg.

structures.label: Front thigh muscle (middle)
structures.sentence: The middle front thigh muscle. It straightens your knee and lifts your leg.

structures.label: Outer thigh muscle
structures.sentence: The outer front thigh muscle. It straightens your knee.

structures.label: Inner thigh muscle above the knee
structures.sentence: The teardrop-shaped muscle above the inside of your knee. It straightens your knee and steadies the kneecap.

structures.label: Outer hamstring
structures.sentence: A back thigh muscle that bends your knee.

structures.label: Inner hamstring
structures.sentence: A back thigh muscle that bends your knee.

structures.label: Inner calf muscle
structures.sentence: The inner part of your calf. It points your foot and helps bend your knee.

structures.label: Outer calf muscle
structures.sentence: The outer part of your calf. It points your foot and helps bend your knee.

joints.label: Knee joint
joints.sentence: The hinge where your thigh bone meets your shin bone.

joints.label: Kneecap joint
joints.sentence: Where your kneecap glides over the front of your thigh bone.

structures.label: Hip bone
structures.sentence: The large bone on the side of your pelvis. Your thigh bone fits into its socket.

structures.label: Thigh bone
structures.sentence: The long bone of your thigh, the strongest bone in your body.

structures.label: Shin bone
structures.sentence: The main bone of your lower leg. It carries your weight down to your ankle.

structures.label: Thin lower leg bone
structures.sentence: The thin bone beside your shin bone. Muscles attach to it.

structures.label: Kneecap
structures.sentence: The small bone at the front of your knee. It helps your thigh muscle straighten your leg.

structures.label: Front thigh muscle (middle)
structures.sentence: The middle front thigh muscle. It straightens your knee and lifts your leg.

structures.label: Outer thigh muscle
structures.sentence: The outer front thigh muscle. It straightens your knee.

structures.label: Inner thigh muscle above the knee
structures.sentence: The teardrop-shaped muscle above the inside of your knee. It straightens your knee and steadies the kneecap.

structures.label: Outer hamstring
structures.sentence: A back thigh muscle that bends your knee.

structures.label: Inner hamstring
structures.sentence: A back thigh muscle that bends your knee.

structures.label: Inner calf muscle
structures.sentence: The inner part of your calf. It points your foot and helps bend your knee.

structures.label: Outer calf muscle
structures.sentence: The outer part of your calf. It points your foot and helps bend your knee.

structures.label: Deep calf muscle
structures.sentence: The flat calf muscle under the gastrocnemius. It keeps you steady when you stand.

structures.label: Buttock muscle
structures.sentence: The big muscle of your buttock. It straightens your hip when you stand up or climb.

structures.label: Side hip muscle
structures.sentence: On the side of your hip. It keeps your pelvis level when you stand on one leg.

joints.label: Hip joint
joints.sentence: The ball-and-socket joint: the top of your thigh bone sits in your hip bone's socket.

joints.label: Knee joint
joints.sentence: The hinge where your thigh bone meets your shin bone.

structures.label: Forehead bone
structures.sentence: The bone of your forehead and the front of your skull.

structures.label: Top of the skull
structures.sentence: The two bones that form the top and sides of your skull.

structures.label: Back of the skull
structures.sentence: The bone at the back and base of your skull. Neck muscles attach to it.

structures.label: Side of the skull
structures.sentence: The bones on the sides of your skull, around your ears. Your jaw hinges on them.

structures.label: Middle of the skull base
structures.sentence: A butterfly-shaped bone in the middle of your skull base, behind your eyes.

structures.label: Upper jaw
structures.sentence: Your upper jaw. It holds your upper teeth.

structures.label: Lower jaw
structures.sentence: Your lower jaw. It moves when you talk and chew.

structures.label: Large base-of-skull muscle
structures.sentence: A short muscle from the base of your skull to your second neck bone. It tips your head back and turns it.

structures.label: Small base-of-skull muscle
structures.sentence: A small muscle from the base of your skull to your top neck bone. It helps tip your head back.

structures.label: Upper slanted skull muscle
structures.sentence: A short muscle at the back of your head, from your top neck bone up to your skull. It helps tip your head back and to the side.

structures.label: Lower slanted neck muscle
structures.sentence: A short muscle between your top two neck bones, just below your skull. It helps turn your head.

joints.label: Jaw joint
joints.sentence: Where your lower jaw hinges on your skull, just in front of your ear.
